title: Pushes the cork down into the wine bottle
text: Pushes the cork down into the wine bottle. So, for the most part this opener is fine. It isn't great, kinda clunky. But about half of the time, it just pushes the cork down into the bottle. I am not sure why, I use it the same every time, but sometimes it just doesn't work right. It wasn't super expensive so, it is what it is. But pretty annoying when the cork is floating around in the wine...
